status: reconstructed from archived policy record; implementation on experiment branch is not the missing original commit
author_instruction: Anything over 99 is acceptable now. Change the rule.
applies_to: A committed configuration selecting this addendum with pangram.policy=reported-over-99-human-v1; existing fresh retry opt-in and budget are independent
preserved_sequence: generate candidate from closed plan and bound voice evidence
progress only after both writing and detector gates pass
gate_policy: Accept if and only if validated Pangram fraction_human > 0.99. Exact equality 0.99 fails. No rounding. Keep recognized nonhuman windows and class labels as recorded evidence; they are not a second all-human gate.
detector_result_validation: Exact source text and detector version
finite fractions in [0,1] with sum within existing tolerance
recognized window labels, confidence and consistent segment counts
recognized prediction_short: Human, Mixed or AI

fresh_candidate_retry.behavior: Fresh candidate from the same closed act plan; no Pangram rejection details or rejected text in the new Expression prompt; full four-layer recheck
fresh_candidate_retry.preservation: Retain original candidates, assessments, detector results and immutable run bindings

existing_expression_repair: Diagnosed writing failures may receive bounded sentence-level editing; Pangram results never authorize sentence repair.
compatibility: Legacy all-human-v1 and earlier addenda remain available and original detector results are immutable.
limitations: This is a reconstructed declaration, not byte-identical to lost v0.4 and does not by itself reproduce the five original model outputs.
